brief: Supervises node processes by declaration: it restarts the dead under a strategy and a budget, and escalates instead of looping.
detail: Declare children with Child, then the Strategy (:OneForOne or :AllForOne), the RestartBudget and optionally a Heartbeat and Monitor subscriptions. A death is a process exit or, with heartbeats on, a silent node. Each restart is counted per child and in a sliding window; beyond the budget the supervisor stops, reports through Escalated and EscalationReason, and leaves the child down. It keeps the house contract Name_() and Cycle(), so it can be hosted on an agent host. StartAll spawns real processes; the documentation run declared children and called the read methods only.
receiver:
o1 = new stzNodeSupervisor()
o1.Child("indexer", "my_indexer.ring", 45810)
o1.Strategy(:AllForOne)
o1.RestartBudget(2, 5000)
